title: lathyrus nissolia subsp. pubescens
intro: Lathyrus nissolia subsp. pubescens, commonly known as the hairy vetchling, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Lathyrus nissolia subsp. pubescens include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties. However, further research is necessary to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Lathyrus nissolia subsp. pubescens for therapeutic purposes.
